region_scene_page.compact: The theatrical 1970s rock road where persona, glitter, gender play, costume, and artifice become as audible as riffs and hooks.
region_scene_page.standard: Glam rock turns performance into argument. Bowie, T. Rex, Roxy Music, Lou Reed, Queen, and related artists use makeup, alter egos, camp, alienation, and flash to make rock feel self-conscious, stylish, and unstable. The record often winks at you. It wants you to hear the song and see the character at the same time.
